skill.summary: Search users and tickets, review macros, and manage support workflows in Zendesk — powered by ClawLink.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of zendesk-support skill.
- Search users and tickets, review macros, and manage support workflows in Zendesk via ClawLink.
- Integrated setup and credential pairing flow powered by ClawLink—no manual Zendesk API key setup required.
- Guides included for plugin installation, pairing, connecting Zendesk, and live tool discovery.
- Follows confirmation prompts and directs users to correct resources for setup and troubleshooting.
